mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, api_code, field_code, field_name, json_path, action, mask_rule, description, sort, version FROM iam_api_field WHERE deleted = 0 AND api_code IN ( #{item} ) ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_api_field SET app_code = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.appCode} END, field_name = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.fieldName} END, json_path = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.jsonPath} END, action = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.action} END, mask_rule = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.maskRule} END, description = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.description} END, sort = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.sort} END, update_by = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.updateBy} END, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN ( #{item.id} )
